rate.reason: Image service requests are too frequent

channel_auth.reason: The current image service has not been authorized
channel_auth.action: Please contact support to check channel permissions and try again

channel_config.reason: The current image service configuration is incorrect
channel_config.action: Please contact support to check the service configuration and try again

input_missing.reason: The reference material does not exist or is no longer accessible
input_missing.action: Please check and replace the reference material before regenerating

invalid_params.reason: Image generation parameters do not meet requirements
invalid_params.action: Please check the model, size, format and quantity before trying again

invalid_media.reason: The reference material format is not supported by the current model
invalid_media.action: Please convert the image format and replace the reference material

duplicate.reason: Detected that the same image task already exists
duplicate.action: Please check the original task results first and do not submit again.

create_unknown.reason: It has not been confirmed whether the picture task was created successfully
create_unknown.action: Please contact support to verify the original task and do not submit it again.

task_internal.reason: Image task failed due to model service internal error
task_internal.action: Please keep the troubleshooting information and contact support to check the results before deciding whether to regenerate it.

task_failed.reason: The model failed to complete this image generation
task_failed.action: Please retain the troubleshooting information and contact support to check the cause before deciding whether to regenerate it.

task_timeout.action: Please contact support to check the original task results and do not regenerate immediately.

cancelled.action: If you still need to generate it, please confirm and resubmit.

query_failed.reason: Temporarily unable to query image task results
query_failed.action: Please check the original task later and do not submit it again

query_missing.reason: The original image task cannot be found at the moment
query_missing.action: Please contact support to check the task record and do not submit it repeatedly.

query_auth.reason: The image service does not have the right to query the original task at the moment.
query_auth.action: Please contact support to check channel permissions and resume the query. Do not submit again.

unknown.reason: The result of the picture task has not yet been confirmed
unknown.action: Please check the original task first or contact support for verification. Do not submit again.

partial.reason: Some pictures have been generated, but not all tasks have been completed.
partial.action: Please contact support to retrieve the image and then decide whether to re-do it.

results_missing.reason: Image task ended, but no available images were returned
results_missing.action: Please contact support to verify the original task and do not submit it again.

download_failed.reason: The image was generated but failed to download
download_failed.action: Please contact support to retrieve the original image, do not regenerate it

request_large.reason: The amount of data requested by the image exceeds the service limit
request_large.action: Please reduce the reference material or compress the image and try again

unsupported.reason: The current image service does not support this request
unsupported.action: Please contact support to check model, interface and locale settings

response_large.reason: The data returned by the image service exceeds the upper limit of the interface
response_large.action: Please contact support to retrieve the results and do not submit again.

source_busy.reason: The resources required for the image task are being occupied
source_busy.action: Please confirm that the reference material is available before trying again

dry_run.reason: This is a service check and no image generation is performed.
dry_run.action: Please contact support to check the channel configuration and try again

moderation.reason: The prompt word or reference material did not pass the content security review
moderation.action: Please adjust the prompt words or reference materials and regenerate

query_rejected.reason: The original image task query was rejected by the service
query_rejected.action: Please contact support to fix the query and do not submit it again.
